get_bank_filing_review.description: Get the figures from a bank's latest reviewed filing: bad loans, capital adequacy, deposits, depositor concentration, provision coverage, and how they changed on the last quarter and year. Where the bank discloses it, also shows how bad loans moved: new ones, recoveries, upgrades and write-offs. Every figure links back to the filing it came from.

description: Screen Indian banks and lenders for failure risk from their public filings and RBI records. Get the current risk board with health scores and chances of failing, an institution's full risk history, a bank's latest filing figures (bad loans, capital, deposits), monitoring warnings and missing disclosures for a whole watchlist, and search the RBI's register of 9,000+ non-bank lenders. No account or API key required.
